punkte.titel: New course: The anatomy of arousal
punkte.text: There are more erogenous zones than penis, breasts and clitoris. With an exercise for your own map of pleasure.
Course 18 has become warmer and more precise, and has been re-recorded.
Couple lessons are now read by Victoria and Martin in turns.
From now on you'll see this screen once after every update.
Below every audio you can report when the voice stresses a word wrongly. The report goes to GitHub, where it is public and needs an account. In discreet mode the link is hidden.
Shared answers from the yes/no list now arrive in full, even if your partner was offline. And when connecting, the app fetches everything since last time.
Below your last message it says “Read” as soon as your partner has seen it – if you both have a current version. You can switch it off in the couple channel's menu; then neither of you sees it.
In the couple channel's menu you can disconnect. If you connect with someone else, the old history is deleted – after asking you first.
The yes/no list is now included in the backup, and when restoring, check-ins and answers are merged instead of overwritten.
10 to 30 minutes just for you: a voice guides you through breathing and a journey across your body, as close as you like. Found in course 18.
Different levels of desire, life phases, pain, shame and performance pressure, and the anatomy of arousal. Plus deepening lessons and a rewritten course 18.
Share a lesson with your partner. You only see each other's answers to the reflection question once both of you have answered.
Notice of new messages even when the app is closed, read receipts, “Disconnect” in the menu – and shared yes/no answers now arrive in full.
Lessons call your partner by name once you enter name and gender in the couple channel.
Couple lessons are read by Victoria and Martin in turns. If a word sounds wrong, you can report it below every audio.
If you were in the beta test, the update channel is now back on stable. For the next test round you can sign up again in your profile under “Receive beta versions”. Thanks for testing!
On English phones the app now appears in English – interface, courses and exercises. You can switch the language in your profile. English recordings come as a pack to download.
The yes/no/maybe list now also asks about watching porn together and about visiting a swingers' club just the two of you, where others may at most watch.
The lessons on erection problems, pain during sex and the anatomy of arousal are worded more carefully: what is established, what is a hypothesis, and when it makes sense to see a doctor.
The shared evening and the self-exploration have labelled buttons to pause, skip and stop. Before the self-exploration, a short note says that nothing has to happen.
The couple channel now explains more precisely what the servers can see: not the content, but when and how often you write.
Updates are only installed with a valid checksum from this project, and damaged backups are rejected with a clear message.
